subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR with a direct-transport fix for preserving Anthropic OAuth beta headers when model headers also set `anthropic-beta`?
rationale: The issue is still source-reproducible, but the formal closing PR is a stale fork branch based on the older wrapper shape and the item is labeled `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr`, so automation should not open a competing repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace with direct-transport fix
options.body: Prefer a same-repository fix that merges or protects required OAuth beta markers in the active direct Anthropic transport and adds a focused regression test for model-level headers.

options.title: Revive the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to retarget it to current main and extend it to cover the direct transport path before review.

options.title: Close only after external proof changes
options.body: Close this issue only if a maintainer verifies Anthropic no longer requires the OAuth beta or current shipped behavior no longer fails for the reported configuration.

recommendation.title: Replace with direct-transport fix
recommendation.body: Prefer a same-repository fix that merges or protects required OAuth beta markers in the active direct Anthropic transport and adds a focused regression test for model-level headers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent direct Anthropic OAuth transport work makes this the closest current routing owner from the inspected history.
